title: Private Helicopter Ride to Hollywood Sign
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Our rates are free of hidden taxes, airport fees, & fuel surcharges. Preferred date and time are not guaranteed. Worldwide Tourism Inc will call to confirm flight upon receipt of order
1 helicopter maximum 3 people 1 front seat and 2 on a back. Everyone have their own private window to see outside view.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: There are many ways to see Hollywood but nothing compares to seeing Hollywood from the sky. Experience the glitz and glamour of Hollywood by soaring over the world famous Universal Studios, up-close and personal to the iconic Hollywood Sign. Be sure to get your camera ready. Approximately 10 minutes.
